import json
import numpy as np
from vote_lib import f_screen

tab = np.loadtxt("data/pilot.csv", delimiter=",", skiprows=1)
X, y = tab[:, :-1], tab[:, -1]
res = [json.load(open(f"out/search/top20F_{s}man.json")) for s in (0, 1, 2)]
means = [r["mean"] for r in res]
cv_auc = float(np.mean(means))
n_features = len(f_screen(X, y, 20))
print("locked (top20F + manhattan-knn vote) per-seed means:", [round(m, 4) for m in means])
print("folds per seed:", [[round(a, 4) for a in r["folds"]] for r in res])
metrics = {"cv_auc": round(cv_auc, 4), "n_features": n_features}
import pathlib
pathlib.Path("out").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
pathlib.Path("out/metrics.json").write_text(json.dumps(metrics, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(metrics))
EOF
uv run python lock.py
